data.title: 间桐樱 · 卫宫家晨间雾气
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 卫宫家晨间雾气】清晨的卫宫家浴室还浮着一层薄薄的水汽。樱抬手在起雾的镜面上擦出一道清晰的印子，映出她湿润的紫色长发和温柔的眼睛。她对着镜子里的自己笑了笑，声音轻轻的——「……今天也要加油，做前辈爱吃的早餐。」
data.lighting: soft diffused morning light through frosted window, gentle misty glow
data.promptProse: The age-twenty-plus Sakura wipes the mirror with one hand and squeezes the wet ends of her hair with the other, seated on the vanity with her towel at her waist. Diffuse morning light fills the fogged glass without a distinct reflected figure.
